About Me
I am a results-driven Business Analyst with a graduate background in Applied Business Analytics and a track record of improving business performance through data-driven insights and strategic process optimization.
I specialize in translating complex datasets into actionable intelligence that enhances operational efficiency, supports executive decision-making, and delivers measurable business outcomes.
My analytical approach combines technical fluency in tools such as Python, R, SQL, and Power BI with strong communication and stakeholder management skills—bridging the gap between data, strategy, and execution.

LinkedIn · GitHub · Request CV



Professional Experience

Assistant Department Manager — Willy Street Co-op, Madison, WI (2019 – Present)
- Led data-driven operational initiatives, improving service delivery and inventory management through performance analytics and demand forecasting.
- Designed process-efficiency models that enhanced employee productivity and optimized staffing levels across shifts.
- Partnered cross-functionally to identify and solve business problems using data insights, improving departmental communication and workflow alignment.
- Developed KPIs to monitor staff performance, loss prevention, and sales metrics, contributing to sustained revenue growth.
- Mentored and trained new staff while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics — Boston University Metropolitan College, Boston, MA
Focused on predictive analytics, statistical modeling, and business intelligence solutions.

Emphasized managerial accounting, operations, and organizational leadership.

Researched cross-cultural communication and information exchange frameworks.
